The MBTA reserves the right to issue partial awards. Quantities listed are for estimated use only, and the MBTA reserves the right to
purchase more or less than estimated within 30 days of the award. The MBTA reserves the right to consider availability and committed
delivery date in determining the successful bidder. The MBTA reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to determine if a Bid is responsive
and the Bidder is responsible. The unit price / rate shall prevail in case of an error in price extension. Prices submitted shall be valid
throughout the Acceptance Period. For any questions regarding this bid, please contact Pat Morgan (person1@mbta.com) If
there is difficulty submitting a quote, please reach out to Fairmarkit HelpDesk at support@fairmarkit.com and a representative will be able
to guide you through the process.
MBTA - If a substitute is offered by the Bidder, it must be offered on an "or equal" basis and be clearly identified in the
submission. The Bidder must provide a complete set of specifications and other descriptive matter for all substitutions
proposed. Any proposed substitution will be evaluated by the MBTA to determine whether the item is, in the opinion of the MBTA,
an "approved" equal. The FTA would like a little more information from our suppliers. If you can't quote on an item please
indicate why you aren't able to quote. Thank you.
